verdict.rationale: Jira's own features page explicitly lists "SAML & SSO" as a capability, so the product claims it secures organization access this way. That claim is only a bare feature-list label, with no detail on setup, supported identity providers, enforcement or plan requirements. missing for 10: documentation of SAML/SSO configuration and supported IdPs, details on org-wide enforcement and user provisioning, plan/tier requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration.
